name: Butter Chicken
description: Creamy tomato-based curry with tandoori chicken.
steps: Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste and grill/tandoor it.
Cook tomato puree with butter till oil separates.
Add spices and cream, simmer 10 mins.
Add grilled chicken, cook 10 more mins.
Serve hot with naan.

name: Dhokla
description: Steamed savory cake made from fermented gram flour batter.
steps: Mix besan, yogurt and water into smooth batter, ferment 4 hrs.
Add eno, pour into greased tray.
Steam for 15-20 mins.
Prepare tempering with mustard seeds, curry leaves, chili.
Pour tempering over dhokla, cut into pieces and serve.

name: Litti Chokha
description: Roasted wheat balls stuffed with sattu, served with mashed veggies.
steps: Make dough with wheat flour and water.
Mix sattu with spices and mustard oil for stuffing.
Stuff dough balls and roast/bake till crisp.
Roast brinjal and tomato, mash with boiled potato for chokha.
Serve litti with chokha and ghee.

name: Puran Poli
description: Sweet flatbread stuffed with jaggery and chana dal filling.
steps: Boil chana dal till soft, mash with jaggery and cardamom.
Make soft dough with wheat flour.
Stuff dal mixture inside dough, roll flat.
Cook on tawa with ghee till golden.
Serve warm with ghee.

name: Dal Baati Churma
description: Baked wheat balls served with lentils and sweet crumble.
steps: Make stiff dough, shape into balls (baati).
Bake/roast baati till golden and crisp.
Cook dal with spices till soft.
Crumble some baked baati with ghee and jaggery for churma.
Serve baati dipped in ghee with dal and churma.

name: Rosogolla
description: Soft spongy cheese balls soaked in sugar syrup.
steps: Curdle milk with lemon juice, strain to get chenna.
Knead chenna smooth, shape into balls.
Boil sugar and water to make syrup.
Add balls to boiling syrup, cook 15-20 mins covered.
Chill and serve.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
description: Spicy rice dish cooked with lentils and vegetables.
steps: Cook rice and dal together till soft.
Cook vegetables with tamarind pulp and masala.
Combine rice-dal mix with vegetable mixture.
Simmer till well blended.
Top with ghee and serve hot.

name: Sambar
description: Tangy lentil-vegetable stew flavored with tamarind.
steps: Cook toor dal till soft and mash.
Cook vegetables with tamarind pulp and sambar powder.
Add cooked dal, simmer together.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Serve hot with rice or idli.

name: Momos
description: Steamed dumplings filled with vegetables or meat.
steps: Make dough with flour and water, rest 20 mins.
Mix filling ingredients with seasonings.
Roll small dough circles, fill and pleat into dumplings.
Steam for 10-12 mins.
Serve hot with spicy chutney.

name: Pizza Margherita
description: Classic pizza with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
steps: Roll out pizza dough into a round base.
Spread tomato sauce evenly.
Top with mozzarella slices.
Bake at high heat till crust is golden.
Garnish with basil and olive oil before serving.

name: Sushi (Nigiri)
description: Vinegared rice topped with fresh fish slices.
steps: Cook rice and season with vinegar, sugar and salt.
Let rice cool to room temperature.
Shape small rice mounds by hand.
Slice fish thinly and place over rice.
Serve with wasabi and soy sauce.

name: Tacos al Pastor
description: Marinated pork tacos with pineapple, cooked on a spit.
steps: Marinate pork with chili-achiote paste overnight.
Cook marinated pork on grill or pan till charred.
Chop pork finely and pineapple into small pieces.
Warm tortillas and fill with pork and pineapple.
Top with onion and cilantro, serve with lime.

name: Croissant
description: Buttery, flaky laminated pastry.
steps: Make dough with flour, yeast, milk, sugar and salt.
Laminate dough with butter through folding, chill between folds.
Roll and cut into triangles, roll into crescent shape.
Proof until doubled in size.
Bake at high heat till golden and flaky.

name: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, shrimp/tofu and tamarind sauce.
steps: Soak rice noodles till soft.
Stir-fry shrimp/tofu with egg in a wok.
Add noodles and tamarind-fish sauce mixture.
Toss with bean sprouts till combined.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: Peking Duck
description: Roasted duck with crispy skin served with pancakes.
steps: Season duck with five spice and let air dry.
Glaze duck skin with honey mixture.
Roast duck until skin is deeply crisp.
Slice duck thinly, especially the skin.
Serve wrapped in pancakes with hoisin sauce and spring onion.

name: Paella
description: Saffron rice dish with seafood or meat and vegetables.
steps: Saute chicken/seafood in olive oil till browned.
Add vegetables and cook briefly.
Add rice, saffron and stock, mix well.
Simmer without stirring till rice absorbs liquid.
Let rest and form crust at bottom before serving.

name: Hamburger
description: Grilled beef patty served in a bun with toppings.
steps: Shape ground beef into patties, season with salt and pepper.
Grill patties till cooked through.
Toast burger buns lightly.
Assemble with lettuce, tomato, cheese and patty.
Add sauces and serve hot.

name: Pho
description: Aromatic beef noodle soup with fresh herbs.
steps: Simmer beef bones with spices for hours to make broth.
Cook rice noodles separately till soft.
Place noodles in bowl, top with raw beef slices.
Pour hot broth over to cook the beef.
Serve with bean sprouts, basil and lime.

name: Kimchi Jjigae
description: Spicy stew made with fermented kimchi and tofu.
steps: Saute kimchi with a little oil till fragrant.
Add water/stock and bring to boil.
Add pork and gochujang, simmer 10 mins.
Add tofu and cook 5 more mins.
Garnish with spring onion and serve hot with rice.

name: Shawarma
description: Spiced meat cooked on a rotating spit, served in flatbread.
steps: Marinate meat with shawarma spices overnight.
Cook meat on grill/spit till charred and cooked through.
Slice meat thinly.
Warm pita bread and fill with meat.
Top with garlic sauce, pickles and tomato, roll and serve.
